research_question: Does a strict explicit-context policy differ from a previously recorded positive evidence decision for a financial identity whose accounting-scope proof was hardcoded?
design: Retrospective source-code and frozen-reference audit plus ten explicitly constructed context-control scenarios; no real-data intervention.
caveats: Constructed contexts are synthetic control probes, not real financial-reporting facts.
An all-supported control is hypothetical and does not independently establish source support for the parent-only identity.
The frozen B6-FIN-002 exclusion is previously known and unadjudicated, not new reviewer-labelled gold.
A changed result is a policy difference, not a measured gain in semantic accuracy or a discovered real-world error.
Do not modify historic B7.2 outputs or the legacy implementation to make this audit pass.
